messages:
Alex W: quick async check-in — API gateway + routing + auth + rate limits.
What I did: landed the header passthrough fix (PR #412).
Blocker: staging shows intermittent 503s on long-poll routes when burst >200 rps. seeing upstream timeouts.
Today: triage logs + prepare rollback plan if repro confirmed. cc @Samir :eyes:

Samir: saw the 503s as well. My hypothesis: connection reuse/keepalive interaction with upstream + our conn-pool change. Running a repro in staging now. If repro is easy we should revert the conn-pool tweak.

Maria G: did a quick canary smoke. Auth tokens failing intermittently for ~8-12% of requests — looks like resets between gateway->auth service. I'll add a circuit-breaker around auth calls to reduce cascading failures.

Jong Park: noticed rate-limit counters spike due to retries: replayed requests are double-counting. Suggest soft bump of per-client token bucket during burst window to reduce false throttles. Draft rule below for discussion:
```
rate_limit:
  scope: client
  unit: minute
  limit: 60
  burst: 30
  behavior: shadow (monitor) -> enforce after validation
```

infra-bot: deploy-queue: Canary (build 2026.03.16-57) auto-rolled back at 11:13 UTC due to 503 spike. See /deploys/2026.03.16-57 for logs.

Alex W: thanks. Samir — if your repro matches, please post a minimal reproducer + timeline; we'll revert the pool change. Maria — please open a ticket for the auth circuit-breaker and include rollback steps.

Samir: repro steps look like this (staging): two loops launching curl long-polls with keepalive, overlap causes conn pool exhaustion quickly. minimal repro:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 250); do
  curl -s -N -H 'Connection: keep-alive' "https://gateway.staging.internal/v1/stream/longpoll?user=test" &
done
wait
```
I'll attach flamegraphs and netstat output once job finishes.

Maria G: opened GH issue #723 and linked the smoke logs (https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/issues/723). Added a test plan: simulate 300 concurrent long-polls for 60s and assert <1% 5xx.

Priya: I'll flip the edge-proxy rate limiter to shadow mode for the next 60m to gather metrics (no enforcement). Will forward metrics to #observability and tag @Alex W.

Alex W: current plan (short):
1) Priya collects shadow metrics + logs
2) Samir verifies repro; revert conn-pool tweak if repro clear
3) Maria lands circuit-breaker PR (aim EOD) with rollout & rollback notes
4) Jong runs perf tests on soft rate-limit bump and posts results
If anyone hits >5% production 5xx, call pager immediately. :thumbsup:

Samir: will update here with repro artifacts. if we revert, i'll open revert PR and ping for quick review.

Maria G: will include acceptance test + rollout checklist in PR. cc @Priya for metric thresholds. :white_check_mark:

Jong Park: will run perf on the soft bump in the noon window and post numbers (~2h).

infra-bot: note: incident-temp channel opened by Alex W at 11:20 UTC (private) for live triage if needed.

Alex W: thanks team — keep async updates here. if anyone needs help pairing on repro ping me.
